description: Implementation of the CacStatusDatabase class managing CAC (Channel Availability Check) status data, including retrieval, update, and report generation for radio channels in a wireless network context.

classes.name: CacStatusDatabase
classes.description: Class managing CAC status data for radio channels, including retrieval, update, and report generation.

methods.name: get_available_channels
methods.description: Returns available CAC channels for a given radio MAC address.

methods.name: get_non_occupancy_channels
methods.description: Returns non-occupancy CAC channels for a given radio MAC address.

methods.name: get_active_channels
methods.description: Returns active CAC channels for a given radio MAC address.

methods.name: update_cac_status_db
methods.description: Updates the CAC status database with information from a radio object.

methods.name: add_cac_status_report_tlv
methods.description: Adds a CAC status report TLV for a radio, updating internal data and populating the TLV.

methods.name: get_completion_status
methods.description: Retrieves the CAC completion status for a radio.

methods.name: add_cac_completion_report_tlv
methods.description: Adds a CAC completion report TLV for a radio, including overlapping channels.
